notes: Why nothing appeared in Spotify. Matches were only written at the END of each phase, so a run that was cancelled, tripped a safety check, lost its sign-in, hit Android's six-hour foreground cap or simply had its process killed wrote NOTHING — however many albums it had already matched. Into Qobuz the phase finishes and the write happens, which is why only the Spotify directions looked broken; into Spotify a ten thousand album library takes hours against a rate-limited search, and any interruption in those hours saved nothing. Albums, tracks and artists are now saved in batches of fifty as they are matched, and whatever is still held is written on the way out of a run that stops early — so 0.3.0's promise that "nothing already matched has been lost" is finally true. It costs no extra requests: fifty is the endpoint maximum and both clients already chunked at it.
